summary: Modules that write something new from your key: a poem or a joke, in the key's own language.

steps.title: Reads your key's language
steps.text: From its spelling, words and script, and from the Context when a spelling fits more than one language.

steps.title: Writes in that language
steps.text: A haiku or a joke as a native speaker would write it, built on your key, never a translation.

steps.title: New every time
steps.text: Each card and each Retry writes a fresh one; nothing is kept from an earlier attempt.
